title: CONNECT-UDP HTTP/3 Request Policy Work Item
summary: Add HTTP/3 CONNECT-UDP request construction and response validation helpers with focused RFC 9298 proof.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3ConnectUdp` with the connect-udp token, request-header construction, request validation, successful-response validation, and proceed/abort policy.
- Compose the existing RFC 9220 Extended CONNECT and RFC 9297 Capsule Protocol helpers rather than adding transport I/O.
- Add focused tests and canonical xrefs for the HTTP/3 request-policy slice.
verification_plan: Run focused CONNECT-UDP request-policy tests, combined RFC 9298 focused tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, coverage triage generation, and diff hygiene before commit.
out_of_scope: UDP socket lifecycle and DNS resolution.
UDP payload forwarding, congestion guidance, ECN behavior, and vulnerable-target filtering.
completion_notes: The RFC 9298 HTTP/3 CONNECT-UDP request-policy floor is implemented and verified locally.
